determinism.unchangedInputDefinition: Byte-identical regeneration requires unchanged baseline Git identities, authority paths and SHA-256 hashes, classification policy, and registered exception records. Wall-clock time and filesystem metadata are excluded.

admission.approval: Explicit approval identity and evidence path; self-approval is invalid.
admission.expiry: A calendar date or objective removal condition that is machine-evaluable and cannot be indefinite.
admission.measuredEffect: Before/after metric, affected budget ID, measurement command, exact commit, and evidence path.
admission.owner: One accountable current owner, not an agent lane name without current ownership evidence.
admission.rationale: Why the exception is necessary and why a compliant alternative is not currently viable.
admission.removalTask: One open task with acceptance criteria that removes the exception.

policy.budgetRule: An exception cannot raise or disable a budget. Budget loosening requires separate explicit user approval and a documented product tradeoff.
policy.expiryRule: Expired, malformed, missing-owner, missing-evidence, or removal-task-closed-without-removal records are invalid and fail closed.
policy.renewalRule: Renewal is a new independently reviewed decision with fresh measured effect; expiry is never silently extended.
